content:
Got them. The resolver's evidence is verified, so here are the original employer application links.

**Verified original employer links**

1. **Barclays** — 2027 Technology Cyber and Security Summer Internship, Knutsford · **OPEN**, deadline 2026-11-01
https://barclays.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/External_Career_Site_Barclays/job/Knutsford-Radbroke-Hall/XMLNAME-2027-Technology-Cyber-and-Security-Summer-Internship-Programme-Knutsford_JR-0000129173
Apply: same URL + `/apply` · Workday requisition verified posted + canApply=true

2. **Addleshaw Goddard** — Cyber Security Graduate Scheme, Leeds · **OPEN**
https://joinus.addleshawgoddard.com/jobs/cyber-security-graduate-scheme-leeds-england-united-kingdom
Apply: same URL + `#Apply`

3. **Actica Consulting** — Graduate Cyber Security Consultant, Guildford · **OPEN**
https://actica.pinpointhq.com/en/postings/973dc768-c64a-47d1-ae2c-9fc66aa2248d
Apply: same URL + `/applications/new`

4. **American Express** — Campus Full-Time Information Security Engineer 2027, London/Brighton/Burgess Hill · availability unverified (Oracle is JavaScript-only)
https://egug.fa.us2.oraclecloud.com/hcmUI/CandidateExperience/en/sites/CX_1/job/26013778

**Three could not be resolved to an employer link**

- **Deloitte** — Forensic Technology Summer Vacation Scheme 2027. Original route opens a Bright Network sign-up gate. Deadline **2026-10-19** (tomorrow).
- **Equilibrium Security** — Junior Penetration Tester. Employer page exists, no identifiable application control.
- **HP** — the link I gave you was a Bright Network category page, not a posting. Codex caught it: that "Information Security Engineer" entry belongs to American Express. No valid HP role was found, and I won't guess one.

**Two corrections worth noting**

- The Barclays link I gave earlier already was an employer domain, but it was a search.jobs.barclays.com shell. The real application route is the Workday requisition above, deadline 2026-11-01.
- The Amex link I gave earlier (26013761) is the undergraduate internship; the full-time 2027 role resolves to a different Oracle requisition, 26013778.

**Summary: 10 roles given → 4 original employer application links confirmed open, 1 employer link found but availability unverified, 3 unresolvable, 1 invalid association caught, 1 already-correct.**

The pattern: the resolver works when the employer has a real, reachable application page. It can't beat a membership gate (Deloitte/Bright Network) or a JavaScript-only shell (Amex Oracle).

Do you want me to add these verified original links to the tracker, replacing the aggregator rows?
When this happens search for that particular application itself on the web or google for the career page link

Searched each one. All three gaps are now closed.

**1. Deloitte — Forensic Technology Summer Vacation Scheme 2027**
Deloitte doesn't expose a per-role URL. Every early-careers application goes through their own portal:
**https://apply.deloitte.co.uk/UKEarlyCareers**
Forensic Technology sits under the Technology stream, which opened 28 Sept / 5 Oct. **Deadline 19 Oct 2026 — tomorrow.** Deloitte also enforces a strict one-application-per-year policy, so if you've already applied to any Deloitte scheme this year, that blocks this one.

**2. Equilibrium Security — Junior Penetration Tester**
The employer page is real; it just has no apply button, which is why the resolver returned "no identifiable application control". The actual route is by email:
**https://equilibrium-security.co.uk/careers/junior-penetration-tester/**
Apply: **CV + cover letter to enquiries@equilibrium-security.co.uk**
Worth knowing: it asks for ~1 year experience and lists SC clearance as desirable — that's a stretch for a first role, and SC would need sponsorship.

**3. "HP" — that role isn't HP**
Searching the specific listing resolved it: it's **American Express**, Burgess Hill. The Bright Network category page I originally pulled it from had mis-attributed it. The real employer page:
**https://careers.americanexpress.com/en/sites/CX_1/job/26013761/**
"Campus – Internship Programme – Undergraduate – Information Security Engineer – 2027 (UK – Burgess Hill)", Job ID 26013761, Technology, hybrid. Bright Network lists the same posting as "Information Security Engineer Internship 2026" with **deadline 23 Oct 2026** — that's the same requisition, already in your tracker.

**Saved as a standing rule.** I've written it into the career-ops skill: when a link is an aggregator or the resolver can't reach the employer page, search the web for that specific application's own career-page link before reporting it — and state plainly which of the three cases it is (employer portal found / email-only application / role actually belongs to a different employer). No guessing a replacement URL when nothing verifiable exists.

**Summary — 3 gaps filled:** Deloitte → employer portal, Equilibrium → email route, HP → corrected to American Express.

One thing needs your call: **Deloitte's deadline is tomorrow**, and it's a one-application-per-year policy. Have you applied to any Deloitte scheme this cycle? If not, that's the most time-critical item on your list.
